tools.name: find_nearby_places
tools.description: Find the closest vending machines, toilets, smoking areas, trash cans, stamp stations or coin lockers in Japan around a point or in one of Ippuku's areas, closest first, with distance, attributes and a link to the map. Use it whenever the user asks where the nearest such place is, for example "Where

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: List the areas Ippuku knows (neighborhoods of big cities such as Shinjuku, Namba or Gion, and smaller towns such as Kamakura), with their slug, center, radius and the number of places per category. Use it to find the slug to pass as area to find_nearby_places, or to see where Ippuku has data.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Show one place with all its attributes, votes, photo count and its link to the map. Use it when the user wants details about a place from find_nearby_places, such as opening hours or whether it is indoors.
